candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: DEEPSIX adds a British Columbia subsea-services operator with commercial diving, inspection ROV and project-execution functions. Evidence: Seven durable sources include the provincial registry, company service surface, CADC, Bowen Island, SEAMOR and UK Companies House. Mission/Public Need read: No mission or Public Need match is proposed; the delivered inspection case demonstrates civil subsea execution but is not a separate defence-demand premise. Unknowns: Beneficial ownership, installed Chinook configuration, capacity, insurance, credentials and the dissolved Scottish entity relationship remain unresolved. Reviewer action: Confirm current fleet and personnel assurance, preserve the municipal payment's unknown work scope, and keep manufacturer specifications distinct from DEEPSIX's installed configuration.

organization.name: NoviFlow
organization.description: Quebec programmable-networking software company, now part of E.C.I. Networks, supplying network operating systems and service-insertion, packet-brokering, telemetry and SRv6 tools for carrier, data-centre and security environments.
organization.ownership: E.C.I. Networks announced its acquisition of NoviFlow on 2024-10-30. The current NoviFlow and E.C.I. sites corroborate continued operation as an E.C.I. company, but the exact post-close legal structure, share chain and workshare are not public.
organization.commercialStatus: NoviFlow licenses programmable-networking software and provides integration and support for supported carrier, data-centre, OEM and ODM environments.
organization.defencePosture: DND names NoviFlow as a partner in an IDEaS 5G network-slicing innovation network; this is research participation, not procurement, product adoption or security accreditation.
organization.dualUsePosture: Programmable networking, telemetry and service insertion have commercial and possible defence-network applications, while public evidence does not establish classified-network readiness.
organization.operatingContext: NoviFlow licenses networking software and provides integration and support for communications-service providers, OEM and ODM platforms and programmable-switch deployments. Its public portfolio includes NoviWare, NoviMapper, NoviBroker and NoviFabric. Transaction language about Canadian-developed research and development does not establish current Canadian headcount or defence-cleared workshare. The 2024 acquisition is a dated ownership event. A 2026 update to the DND programme page does not date NoviFlow's performance, and the 2025 technical paper reports a deployment without a deployment date. The current Dorval headquarters supersedes the older Montreal owner address retained in CIPO records.
organization.canadianFootprint: NoviFlow Inc. is the active registered owner of NOVIWARE in Canada, with a current Dorval headquarters and Canadian parent. DND lists NoviFlow in a Canadian university-led 5G network-slicing innovation network.

organization.name: MetOcean Telematics
organization.description: Dartmouth designer and manufacturer of satellite-connected oceanographic, tracking, search-and-rescue and defence or security telemetry systems, including drifting buoys, acoustic profiling floats, beacons and Iridium communications hardware and services.
organization.commercialStatus: MetOcean offers oceanographic and satellite-telemetry hardware, airtime, tracking services and support through direct sales and its Iridium partner channel.
organization.disclosedFinancingSummary: NRC IRAP agreement 1040736 provides CAD 75,000 for a 2026 defence-readiness requirements project; this is contribution funding, not equity, procurement or delivered-product revenue.
organization.defencePosture: DND ACANs name MetOcean or its NiKA and iSLDMB products as pre-identified suppliers for proposed requirements, and NRC funds a naval-requirements study; none of these records confirms award, delivery or operational acceptance.
organization.dualUsePosture: MetOcean's oceanographic buoys, acoustic profiling floats and satellite telemetry serve civil, environmental, search-and-rescue and defence or security contexts, with each procurement and maturity claim bounded separately.
organization.currentActivity: NRC IRAP agreement 1040736 provides CAD 75,000 from 2026-03-24 to 2026-05-22 for MetOcean to engage naval organizations and researchers on long-term requirements for autonomous acoustic subsea devices.
organization.operatingContext: MetOcean designs and manufactures data-acquisition and telemetry systems at its Dartmouth headquarters and offers satellite IoT hardware, airtime and support, ocean and ice tracking, drifting buoys, search-and-rescue products and custom defence or security systems. The official company history states that MetOcean Data Systems, incorporated in 1984, and JouBeh Technologies, established in 2008, combined as MetOcean Telematics effective 2017-01-01. Treat these as constituent history, not unqualified aliases or entity-number continuity. NRC IRAP agreement 1040736 is defence-readiness and customer-requirements exploration, not a delivered device, procurement award or operational adoption.
organization.canadianFootprint: Federal records identify legal recipient Metocean Telematics Limited, business number 103650503, at 11 Thornhill Drive in Dartmouth. The official site places headquarters, research and development and production there; Iridium independently identifies Dartmouth development and manufacturing. The official 40,000-square-foot and 20,000-square-foot manufacturing figures remain owner-controlled.
